en: A black-and-white panoramic view of a lakeside town surrounded by mountains. The foreground shows a dense historic center with multi‑storey buildings, a prominent clock tower near the waterfront, quays and small piers along the shore, and tree‑lined promenades. In the background, flat valley land extends toward high, rugged mountains. The lower border of the card bears the printed caption "RIVA - Panorama".
